questions.question: After ten men with leprosy were healed and only one came back to thank Him, what did Jesus ask?

answers.text: Why did the others not wait
Who told the others to leave

questions.question: When Jesus saw ten men with leprosy calling out to Him, what did He tell them to do?

answers.text: Go show yourselves to the priests
Go wash seven times in the Jordan
Come close and touch My cloak
